subject.title: fix(meeting-bot): avoid stale state during transcript and browser recovery

question: Should Google Meet change from the previously preserved unknown-microphone behavior to fail-closed readiness, accepting that sessions without an explicit unmuted observation will stop before talkback and audio bridging?
rationale: The merged extraction identified the old behavior as a shipped contract and deferred this exact policy choice; source and mocked tests can establish implementation consistency, but they cannot decide the intended compatibility tradeoff or prove how often live Meet returns an unknown state.

options.title: Adopt fail-closed after live proof
options.body: Approve explicit-unmuted readiness after a signed-in Meet run proves normal talkback still succeeds and unknown state produces actionable browser-unverified diagnostics.

options.title: Preserve shipped semantics
options.body: Keep unknown microphone state compatible with current behavior while landing the independent transcript and recovery repairs.

options.title: Split the policy change
options.body: Merge the transcript and tab-ranking fixes separately and revisit microphone readiness with dedicated product discussion and proof.

recommendation.title: Adopt fail-closed after live proof
recommendation.body: Approve explicit-unmuted readiness after a signed-in Meet run proves normal talkback still succeeds and unknown state produces actionable browser-unverified diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the shared runtime in merged history and recorded the microphone policy as a deferred follow-up.
